ideas.title: Following the Money in Medicaid Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the financial transactions and entities involved in Medicaid fraud schemes
questions: What are the common financial patterns in Medicaid fraud cases?
How do entities involved in Medicaid fraud schemes launder money?
ideas.insight: I believe that following the money trail in Medicaid fraud cases can lead to identifying key entities and patterns. This story would involve analyzing financial transactions and identifying potential money laundering schemes.
